title: Senior Support Analyst
bullets: Diagnose and resolve complex Level 2 cases across AI agents, integrations, and REST APIs, providing swift first-line diagnosis of live issues.
Reproduce ambiguous behaviors and drive root-cause analysis with SQL, OpenSearch logs, and API testing tools such as Postman.

Monitor AI-agent execution via Langfuse traces and author detailed Jira engineering escalations with reproduction steps, logs, and technical evidence.
